question.text: Which one of the following techniques is not used to spot components of a mixture separated on thin layer chromatographic plate?

options.text: Visualisation agent as a component of mobile phase

solution.text:
Thin Layer Chromatography is a technique used to isolate non-volatile mixtures. The experiment is conducted on a sheet of aluminium foil, plastic, or glass which is coated with a thin layer of adsorbent material. The material usually used is aluminium oxide, cellulose, or silica gel.

The sample spots can be observed under a UV light chamber, I2 solid or by spraying of an appropriate reagent which can react with the sample spot.
